dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct, high-contrast white horizontal bands are visible; the lower band on the greater coverts is thicker and sharper than the upper band.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Prominent and sharp pale edges are visible along the folded primary and secondary feathers, contrasting strongly with the dark feather bodies.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Diffuse and low-distinctness transition between the dark grey crown and the slightly lighter grey-brown mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white outer rectrices contrast sharply with the dark central tail feathers.
